title: Marriage Certificate — J. W. Blakey and Martha J. Chenoweth, Grayson County, Texas, 1865
text:
THE STATE OF TEXAS.— COUNTY OF GRAYSON.

To Any Judge of the District Court,
CHIEF JUSTICE OF THE COUNTY COURT, ORDAINED MINISTER OF THE GOSPEL, OR JUSTICE OF THE PEACE
IN AND FOR THE COUNTY OF GRAYSON,— GREETING.

You are hereby authorized to celebrate the Rites of Matrimony, between J. W. Blakey and Martha J. Chenoweth and make due return to the Clerk of the County Court of said County, within sixty days thereafter, certifying your action under this License.

Witness My Official Signature and Seal of Office at Office in Sherman this 7th day of November A. D., 1865

G. A. Dickerman
Clerk of the County Court of Grayson County.

I. J. M. Binkley certify that on the 9th day of Nov. 1865 I united in marriage J. W. Blakey and Martha J. Chenoweth the parties above named.

Witness my hand this 11th day of November 1865

J. M. Binkley Minister
of the Gospel

Copy of Marriage Record of James Whitsett Blakey II as found in County Clerk's record at Sherman, Texas on May 6, 1968 by Rev. R.L.Blakey a great grand son of J.W.B. II.
R.L.B.
notes: This is a marriage license/certificate document, not a newspaper clipping, though filed in the Newspapers image folder. The document is a photocopy of a handwritten original. Bottom note: 'Copy of Marriage Record of James Whitsett Blakey II as found in County Clerk's record at Sherman, Texas on May 6, 1968 by Rev. R.L.Blakey a great grand son of J.W.B. II.' The officiating minister signed as 'I. J. M. Binkley' in the certification line and 'J. M. Binkley' in the signature. The county clerk is G. A. Dickerman.
